verdict.summary: The diff only corrects stale explanatory comments and docstrings to reflect the bidirectional retriage behavior introduced by #586. The revised claims match the implementation: retriage boards only status:untriaged/status:ready issues, skips gates and ownership states before classification, repairs a role-less ready issue when classifier output restores enumerability, and deliberately leaves an ambiguous-role ready issue unchanged because exclusion_reason accepts any role while routing_refusal rejects multiple roles. The quarantine failure explanation is also accurate: an issue with neither status attestation is not retriageable. No executable behavior, trust check, workflow permission, or test assertion is changed, and no reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
